description: This file is a Node.js script implementing an MCP proxy mechanism, handling command-line arguments, JSON payload decoding, line rewriting, and process spawning for communication with backend services.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes and validates the base64url-encoded payload passed via command-line arguments.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines if a method should have the MCP servers injected based on its name.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Rewrites a line of input if it matches specific criteria and injects MCP server information.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current script is the main module being run.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function controlling payload decoding, child process spawning, input/output handling, and process cleanup.
